static_observation.assembly: The stock interprets the second argument as a byte, clamps values below 6 to 5 and values above 24 to 25, then calls i2c_w_bits(haptic, 6, 0xffffffe0, value). The helper return is discarded.
static_observation.limits: The static contract and KCFI type ID are evidenced; physical hardware behavior and whole-driver semantic equivalence remain unestablished.
